50883704.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to GST-tagged recombinant Grb2 SH2 domain by Biacore assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: The binding affinity of these compounds was evaluated by Biacore assays. The GST-tagged recombinant Grb2 SH2 domain was immobilized on a CM5 sensor chip (Biacore 3000, GE Healthcare) at a level of 1000–1200 response units (RU). The compounds were dissolved in HBS-EP buffer (10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.005% P20) and injected at concentrations ranging from 0.1 to 100 μM at a flow rate of 30 μL/min. The association phase lasted for 120 s, followed by a 120 s dissociation phase. The sensor chip was regenerated with 10 mM glycine-HCl (pH 2.0) for 30 s. The data were analyzed using BIAevaluation 4.1 software (GE Healthcare). The binding affinity (Kd) was determined by fitting the sensorgrams to a 1:1 Langmuir binding model.
original_paragraph.Table 1 footnote: a The binding affinity of these compounds was evaluated by Biacore assays.
